rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for close examination or thorough inspection.

example.english: Before submitting the report, I give the figures careful scrutiny several times.
example.traditional: 我交份報告之前，會將啲數字仔細檢查幾次。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gaau1 fan6 bou3 gou3 zi1 cin4 wui6 zoeng1 di1 sou3 zi6 zi2 sai3 gim2 caa4 gei2 ci3

rows.note: Use this for formal or procedural scrutiny of a case, application, report, or situation.

example.english: This application is still under the committee’s scrutiny.
example.traditional: 呢宗申請仲等緊委員會審查。
example.jyutping: ni1 zung1 san1 cing2 zung6 dang2 gan2 wai2 jyun4 wui2 sam2 caa4

rows.note: Use this when the scrutiny means sustained, detailed study rather than checking for faults.

example.english: This market report deserves close scrutiny.
example.traditional: 呢份市場報告值得仔細研究。
example.jyutping: ne1 fan6 si5 coeng4 bou3 gou3 zik6 dak1 zi2 sai3 jin4 gau3
